title: LiTo was linked to an Apple GitHub repository
summary: On 2026-05-21, the sealed LiTo development-line record linked to the Apple GitHub repository `apple/ml-lito`. This is a material public project-reference milestone, but the supplied evidence does not establish the repository's contents, release status, or whether this was LiTo's first public availability.
